_comment: The schema of the okf_check: block in okf-base.yaml. okf-verify enforces it (okf-verify --check-config) and okf-check calls that, so the two tools cannot disagree. A node is {keys: {name: node}} (a mapping with exactly those keys), {list: node} (a list whose items are node), {enum: [values]} (one of those strings) or {type: string} (a non-empty string). To add an option, add its key under the top-level keys.
